messages:
Claire Park: Quick sync — Sales asked for a commit matrix + add-on SLA tiers + exception playbook for enterprise contracts. Need decisions by EOD Wed. Can we align on scope?

Raj Patel: +1. Customer Atlas is pushing for burst credits + guaranteed priority routing on Dedicated. They'll pay for predictability but need clear limits.

Marta Gomez (Finance): We need revenue recognition clarity. Proposing 3 commit bands: S (0-500k/mo), M (500k-2m), L (>2m). Add-on discounts scale with band. I'll post a model.

Ben Liu (Legal): Need to define soft vs hard caps, overage terms, and a 'burst abuse' clause. I can draft a standard exception workflow tied to approvals.

Lina Chen (Eng): Priority routing + reserved burst capacity doable, but requires capacity tokens and a routing SLA matrix. Rough infra delta: +~15% cost for priority buckets. Also need KV cache policies for burst fallbacks.

Noah Kim (Solutions): From CSMs: onboarding complexity is real. Onboarding support tiers must map to commit band. Add-on response-time SLAs need measurable SLOs.

Claire Park: Draft launch criteria: 1) commit bands + revenue model; 2) add-on price book + SLA defs; 3) legal templates + exception workflow; 4) Eng implementation plan + perf impact and canary plan; 5) customer playbook and FAQ.

Raj Patel: For negotiation, propose 3-month trial burst credits for new L customers and automatic fallback to lower model variant if capacity constrained.

Marta Gomez: I'll upload a pricing model spreadsheet and a sensitivity table: https://redwood.atlassian/PRICING/commit-model (internal link)

Ben Liu: I'll draft contract language and an approval checklist (Sales VP + Legal signoff). Also propose a standard amendment for committed upgrades.

Lina Chen: Eng estimate: ~3 sprints to add quota tokens, routing policy, and telemetry hooks; +1 sprint for rollout and canary gating. We need a feature-flag path.

Claire Park: @Lina yes — plan for canary + A/B routing. Add rollout policy config in Console. We'll require perf regression <5% token latency.

Noah Kim: I'll own the customer playbook and a one-pager FAQ. Will coordinate with Sales on negotiation scripts.

Claire Park: Owners noted. I'll collate artifacts into a PRD and schedule review on Thursday. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Ben Liu: FYI — I'll add a clause to handle regulatory customers where Private deployments need separate SLAs.

Marta Gomez: Action items: I'll share model by EOD Tue. Finance to propose list prices and list-discount ladder.

Raj Patel: I'll gather customer asks and priority list for the pilot.

Lina Chen: Will scope infra tickets and post a rough timeline.

Claire Park: Perfect. Next sync Thursday 10am. If anyone can't make, drop updates inline here.
